high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job (DEFGDGD) creates and initializes Generation Data Groups (GDGs) for backing up transaction reference data in the CardDemo application, an AWS Mainframe Modernization demo system. It defines three GDG base entries — for Transaction Type, Transaction Category, and Disclosure Group — each with a retention limit of 5 generations, then immediately loads the first generation of each GDG by copying data from existing flat files. The overall business purpose is to establish a versioned backup structure for critical card transaction reference data, ensuring historical copies are maintained and automatically managed through the GDG mechanism.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The job name is DEFGDGD and the accounting/description field is 'DEF DB2 GDG'. This identifies the job to the system and provides a brief description of its purpose.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class A, which determines the initiator queue the job is submitted to. It controls scheduling priority and resource allocation based on installation-defined class definitions.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log and system messages. Class 0 determines where the job's JES message output (job log) is routed, typically to a specific spool output class defined by the installation.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies that the user whose user ID is stored in the symbolic parameter &SYSUID (the submitting user) will receive a TSO notification message when the job completes, informing them of the job's completion status.

job_details.purpose: Defines a Generation Data Group (GDG) base entry named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.BKUP in the system catalog, with a limit of 5 generations and SCRATCH option to automatically delete rolled-off generations.
job_details.outputs: GDG base AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.BKUP defined in catalog; SYSPRINT

job_details.purpose: Creates the first generation of the Transaction Type GDG by copying the existing sequential dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.PS into the new GDG generation AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.BKUP(+1). This step is skipped if STEP10 returned a non-zero condition code.
job_details.outputs: SYSUT2: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.BKUP(+1) (NEW, CATLG, LRECL=60, RECFM=FB, BLKSIZE=600, SPACE=(TRK,(1,1),RLSE)); SYSPRINT
